text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Morning. It's rare to catch you humming.

text_block_list.text:
Eek! T-Тренер?! I-I-I guess I was just
reminiscing
on some memories...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
You see, I happened to bump into
Opera O at the
park yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: And wouldn't you know? I was granted a front-row seat to her performance, The Opera Overlord: Five-Hour Edition!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Reminiscing on that wonderful voice of
hers
brings me courage. I'll probably get
through
today without making a single
mistake!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she had herself an exciting
day off!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
